notes.title: Princess Daphne now with Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Our awesome SRPG [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384330/Princess_Daphne_and_the_Orcs/]Princess Daphne and the Orcs[/url][/b] now features [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38570756/18aca369c46e59232ab0caeb00b131231662110c.png[/img]

Collect beautiful images of your favorite characters,
[list]
[*] Princess Daphne
[*] Knight Avalon
[*] Ranger Muriel 
[*] Lord Balthazar
[*] and the feared Orc Lord Skandar
[/list]

Make sure to follow our page to enjoy our games, now and in the future!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33770029]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33770029[/url]

Thank you for making Princess Daphne a success!
